columnHints.duration: Riding time in hours and minutes, for example 1:30 for an hour and a half.
columnHints.elevationGain: Total climbing of the ride in metres.
columnHints.speed: Average speed: distance divided by riding time. Athlify calculates it automatically.
columnHints.tss: Training Stress Score: how much a ride loaded you. 100 is about one hour at your threshold power.
columnHints.heartRate: Average heart rate in beats per minute. Hover over a value to see the lowest and highest heart rate.
columnHints.effort: How hard the ride felt, from 1 (very easy) to 10 (maximal).
columnHints.mood: How you felt during the ride, from “Very bad” to “Very good”.
columnHints.wind: Wind conditions during the ride, from “Calm” to “Stormy”.
columnHints.gadgets: Devices you had with you on the ride, for example a bike computer or heart rate strap.

columnHints.bodyFatPercentage: Share of body fat in your weight. Body composition scales estimate it; compare the trend rather than single values.
columnHints.musclePercentage: Share of muscle mass in your weight, estimated by the body composition scale.
columnHints.waterPercentage: Share of body water in your weight. It varies with the time of day and how much you drank.
columnHints.boneMass: Estimated weight of your bones. It barely changes over months.
